vehicle_class_note: 407 ETR publishes FIVE classes: motorcycle, light, medium, heavy single unit, heavy multiple unit. Only light is captured here.
time_band_rule: Priced by TIME OF ENTRY for the whole trip - ETR does not split a traversal at band boundaries. Bands are LOCAL time (America/Toronto).

fees.name: Trip Toll ChargeNot a per-kilometre charge.
Account FeeMonthly fee for accounts without a transponder.
Camera ChargeApplies to a camera-recorded trip (no transponder detected).
Unrecognizable Plate ChargeApplied each time a vehicle uses Highway 407 ETR without a valid transponder and the front or rear licence plates are altered, not visible or not recognizable.
Returned Payment FeeApplied for each returned unpaid payment due (for example, due to insufficient funds).
